protocol.primary: Terminal accuracy and unchanged-component preservation on the first successor in each condition; original returns test continued old-response availability.
protocol.information: Same public interface and matched control seeds in all branches. Change labels configure only the lab. No inserted challenge or terminal feedback during learning.
protocol.costs: Prefix acquisition shared and reported once; each branch also reports its complete prefix-plus-suffix bill. Frozen-C prediction reference has separate evaluation costs and is not a research algorithm arm.
protocol.selection: Keep all registered cases, including failed prefixes and unresolved or erroneous successors. No resampling.
protocol.analysis: Report each phase, actual nested calls, exact retained definitions, actions, remaining resources. Missing stop reasons remain unknown; do not infer from unused budget.
protocol.scope: A gain change of the total response contribution, a radius change of the event relation, and no change in one finite family. No claim of general mechanism discovery or universal revision choice.

paired_uncertainty.interpretation: Resource response to an environmental change, not an algorithm superiority comparison.
